svg.title: Magnetocrystalline Anisotropy Energy Landscapes: Uniaxial and Cubic Conventions
svg.desc: Two-panel scientific figure comparing (a) uniaxial polar excess energy curves for easy-axis, easy-plane, and easy-cone regimes plus the scalar energy offset between -K_u1 cos^2(theta) and K_u1 sin^2(theta), and (b) exact (001)-plane and (1-10)-plane cubic anisotropy profiles for K_c1 > 0 (<100> easy) and K_c1 < 0 (<111> easy).
